scope: Concrete private ARRAY shape facts in bounded static source-access discovery

contracts.inspection: Checked inert source-flow contracts only; no target import, execution, eval or runtime coercion calls
contracts.shape: Inherit known actual dimensions and STRING element capacities into declared private layouts; retain converted terminal types and named component identities
contracts.aliases: Borrowed references retain original locations; private parameter writes and function returns do not write back into caller storage
contracts.metadata: Known ARRAY_LEN logical dimensions bound existing small loops; probe receivers and dimension expressions retain source-order effects exactly once without reading stored cells
contracts.returns: Merge equal resolved result schemas; disagreeing results retain declared constraints; scalar result conversions invalidate uncast branch constants
contracts.gaps: Known shape conflicts, unknown/private partial schemas, missing derived leaves and potentially converted SHORT sentinels stay explicit
contracts.format: Existing generated input-plan, discovery report, template and run-document formats unchanged
contracts.boundary: Complete supported source-access coverage does not prove successful execution, termination, host/controller behavior or native equivalence
